title: Learning Simple Test-Time Environments for LLM Web Agents
abstract: arXiv:2608.29305v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents have demonstrated remarkable proficiency in manually constructed environments, yet their performance frequently collapses when transitioned to complex real-world settings. Existing research largely attribute this degradation to the compositional generalization gaps in LLMs on combinations of multiple simple, well-structured environments. In this work, we propose that LLM web agents can learn simple environment observations at test time. Specifically, we introduce trial steps for agents to decompose a complex environment observation into sub-modules, and implement a label-free learning method, Test-Time Environment Decomposition (TTED), to adapt agent behaviors with experience during inference. translated_title: 面向大语言模型网络智能体的简单测试时环境学习
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）智能体在人工构建的环境中已展现出卓越的能力，然而当迁移到复杂的真实世界场景时，其性能往往会大幅崩溃。现有研究大多将这种性能退化归因于LLM在多个简单、结构良好的环境组合上的组合泛化缺口。在本工作中，我们提出LLM网络智能体可以在测试时学习简单的环境观测。具体而言，我们引入试验步骤，让智能体将复杂的环境观测分解为子模块，并实现了一种无标签的学习方法——测试时环境分解（TTED），以在推理过程中利用经验来调整智能体的行为。我们的实证评估表明，该框架在合成与真实基准测试中均展现出有效性，显示（1）在较简单的子环境中获得的经验收益可以被有效地组合……
tldr: 提出测试时环境分解（TTED）方法，让LLM网络智能体在推理时将复杂环境观测分解为简单子模块并无标签地积累经验，从而有效提升其在复杂真实环境中的表现。
en_tdlr: Proposes Test-Time Environment Decomposition (TTED), a label-free method that enables LLM web agents to decompose complex environment observations into simple sub-modules at test time and adapt their behaviors through experience during inference.
